answer:
I fixed the Meal plan's App side so it fits an iPhone with no sideways scrolling. The app check found no problems at phone or desktop widths.

The old app was a table fixed at 900 px wide. It's now one card per day, with Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner and Snack listed inside. A "Shop" tag shows on days where Shop is Yes, and the day's Notes appear at the bottom of the card. On wider screens the cards sit in 2 or 3 columns.

I also switched it to the app's own colors, so light and dark mode follow your phone's setting. Your note's text is unchanged.

A note can have an app: one HTML document shown on the note's App side, next to its Text side. A habit grid, a budget with totals, flashcards, a trip planner.
